findings.issue: Task 12 What-to-do step 1 instructs the agent to read audit reports from 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/working/task-9/code-reviewer-*.json', 'task-10/security-auditor-*.json', 'task-11/test-reviewer-*.json'. These paths do not match where Tasks 9, 10, and 11 actually write their outputs. Task 9 writes to 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/code-audit.json'; Task 10 writes to 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/security-audit.json'; Task 11 writes to 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/test-audit.json'. The logs/working/task-{9,10,11}/ directories do not exist and will never be created by any task in this feature. As a consequence, the QA agent in Task 12 will silently proceed without reading the audit findings — defeating the critical-findings-gate described in the task description.
findings.fix: In Task 12 What-to-do step 1, replace the three 'logs/working/task-N/*.json' paths with the correct paths: 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/code-audit.json' (Task 9), 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/security-audit.json' (Task 10), 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits/test-audit.json' (Task 11). Also update the same section in Task 12 Context Files.

findings.issue: Task 10 Details → Files section contains a literal mkdir/cat shell command 'mkdir -p logs/audits && cat > logs/audits/security-audit.json' using a short relative path that omits the 'work/t-hunted-pt-source/' prefix. If an agent follows this command literally from the project root it creates './logs/audits/' in the project root instead of the feature folder. Task 11's equivalent line correctly uses the full path 'mkdir -p work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits'.
findings.fix: Change the inline command hint in Task 10 line 178 from 'mkdir -p logs/audits && cat > logs/audits/security-audit.json' to 'mkdir -p work/t-hunted-pt-source/logs/audits' (matching Task 11's phrasing). The canonical output path stated above the hint already uses the correct full path, so this is a consistency fix.

findings.issue: Task 10 What-to-do step 3 instructs the auditor to use 'git diff main...HEAD' to see only this feature's changes. The feature branch 'feature/t-hunted-pt-source' was branched from 'dev', not from 'main'. Using 'main...HEAD' as the diff range includes all commits from main→dev (framework install, bug fixes, etc.) — roughly 11 additional commits and hundreds of unrelated files — making it harder to focus on feature-only changes. Task 12 consistently uses 'origin/dev' as the comparison base, which is the correct target branch for this feature.
findings.fix: Change 'git diff main...HEAD' in Task 10 step 3 to 'git diff origin/dev...HEAD' (matching Task 12's convention) to scope the diff to feature-only changes.

findings.issue: Task 12 acceptance criterion and description states '933+ существующих тестов'. The actual baseline test count on the current branch is 935 (confirmed by pytest --collect-only). While 935 satisfies the '933+' floor and the claim is technically not wrong, the 2-test discrepancy could cause minor confusion if an agent reports 935 and the reviewer cross-checks against the '933' figure.
findings.fix: Update the baseline count in Task 12 acceptance criteria from '933+' to '935+' (or '935+ existing tests') to match the actual collected count.
